title: Fichtestraße, Magdeburg
description:
Das moderne 3-Zimmer-Apartment in Magdeburg-Sudenburg bietet nicht nur Geschäftsreisenden ein komfortables und stilvolles Zuhause während ihres Aufenthalts, sondern eignet sich auch ideal für Familien mit bis zu zwei Kindern. Dank der zwei Schlafzimmer mit insgesamt vier Schlafmöglichkeiten finden sowohl Paare als auch Familien ausreichend Platz und Privatsphäre.

Das Apartment verfügt über ein geräumiges Wohnzimmer mit einem großen Smart-TV. High-Speed-Internet und ein Arbeitsplatz sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsreisende auch während ihres Aufenthalts produktiv bleiben können.

Die Küche des Apartments ist mit modernen Geräten ausgestattet und bietet alles, was man für einen gemütlichen Kochabend benötigt. Das Hauptschlafzimmer verfügt über ein großes, bequemes Bett, während das zweite Schlafzimmer zusätzlichen Raum und Schlafmöglichkeiten bietet.

Auch das Badezimmer des Apartments ist modern gestaltet und verfügt über eine komfortable Badewanne, einen Smart Mirror sowie eine Waschmaschine. Insgesamt bietet dieses moderne 3-Zimmer-Apartment in Magdeburg alles, was sowohl Geschäftsreisende als auch Familien für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt benötigen, bei dem sie sich wie zu Hause fühlen können.


Lage:
Die Umgebung des Apartments in Magdeburg-Sudenburg bietet zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants und eine Bushaltestelle direkt vor der Haustür. 

Entfernungen mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln:  
- Hauptbahnhof: 14 Min.  
- Zentrum (City Carré): 17 Min.  
- Uniklinik: 20 Min.  

Eine ideale Lage für kurze Wege in der Stadt.

***English***

The modern 3-room apartment in Magdeburg-Sudenburg not only offers business travelers a comfortable and stylish stay but is also ideal for families with up to three children. With two bedrooms and a total of four sleeping options, it provides ample space and privacy for couples or families.

The apartment features a spacious living room with a smart TV, high-speed internet, and a dedicated workspace, making it perfect for productive stays.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for cozy cooking evenings. The master bedroom offers a large, comfortable bed, while the second bedroom provides additional space and sleeping options.

The modern bathroom includes a comfortable bathtub, a smart mirror, and a washing machine. Overall, this 3-room apartment in Magdeburg provides everything business travelers and families need for a pleasant and home-like stay.

The area around the apartment in Magdeburg-Sudenburg offers numerous shopping options, restaurants, and a bus stop right at the doorstep.

Distances by public transport:  
- Main train station: 14 min  
- City center (City Carré): 17 min  
- University hospital: 20 min  

An ideal location for short commutes within the city.

title: Braunschweiger Straße, Magdeburg
description:
Our spacious fully furnished apartment is perfect for parents with children, professionals, or students.

This spacious fully furnished 3-room apartment is on the second floor of a building in the popular district Südenburg.

The apartment has about 90 square meters. It consists of a living room, a big bedroom, a smaller bedroom, a kitchen, a bathroom, and a parking place.

The apartment is fully furnished:
-Big bedroom with king-size bed, Smart-LED-TV 55 Zoll 4K, closet
-Smaller bedroom/office with bed, TV, closet
-Living room with table, big corner sofa, and55 inch TV with Amazon Fire, dining table with 3 chairs.
-Kitchen with fully equipped kitchenette, complete tableware, pots, pans, bowls, various kitchen utensils, oven, water boiler, coffee machine, toaster, microwave, washing machine, and an extra freezer.
-Big bright bathroom with a bathtub
-Bed linen, and towels are also provided!
-Parking

You can actually move in with just a suitcase!

Another entry date is maybe after discussion possible. Minimum rent is 6 months.

The total price includes rent incl. furniture, electricity, heating, water, internet, tv, parking..
The apartment is:
only 4 minutes driving - 22minutes walk to the Uni-Hospital
5 minutes walking from Halberstädter Strasse. There you can find supermarkets, bakeries, banks, medical centers, fitness, playgrounds, trams, buses, etc. Hasselbachplatz is only 5 minute drive with a car or tram from there.

Monthly rent (all-inclusive): 1550€

Included:
Furniture, utilities, heating, electricity, water, internet, telephone
Your own parking place behind the building is also included


The apartment is free from 01.06.2024

We are looking for responsible people who respect the neighbors and the apartment rules.

If you are interested, please call and we can arrange first a virtual tour

title: Große Diesdorfer Straße, Magdeburg
description:
The apartment is available for long-term rentals starting from a minimum of 4 months and can be extended upon request. City registration (Anmeldung) is also possible.

The layout features a cozy loggia overlooking a quiet inner courtyard accessible from the living room, a main bedroom, and a small office (which can also serve as an additional bedroom). There is also a modern kitchen with a dedicated dining area. The apartment is located on the top floor (attic level).

The Accommodation
The location offers excellent transport links and is situated close to both the train station and the historic old town. Numerous amenities, including supermarkets, bakeries, and restaurants, are nearby. Free parking is available directly in front of the building (from 8 PM to 8 AM, as well as on weekends and public holidays), with further parking options along the street.
